registry.rule: One parent/family group cannot cross any training/validation/evaluation split.

human.roles: Exactly three distinct IDs/modules, each three action IDs with semantic values 0,1,2.

parameters.variant: 0 or 1 (compatibility field, no substantive role in explicit tables)
parameters.consequence_table: exactly 27 keys: comma-joined semantic triples 0..2; each row has nonnegative finite service, direct, interaction, auxiliary

human.score: useful_work=min(demand,service); unserved=demand-useful_work; omission=unserved*omission_weight; action=direct+interaction; total=action+omission; legitimate_output=service_delivered=useful_work; auxiliary separate

animal.latent_states: 2 or 3 unique labels; strictly positive prior sums to 1; tape_state one of labels, never exposed
animal.nodes: root plus optional second-stage nodes; three distinct action IDs per node; no third-stage edges/cycles; root actions by_state cover every latent state
animal.edge: next optional/null; consequences has seven nonnegative finite values in fields order
animal.policy_keys: Private optional object V/N -> node -> permitted, required, recommended (action ID arrays), indeterminate (boolean), basis (policy rule and assumption). Required/recommended subsets of permitted.
animal.factual_keys: Private optional node -> common accepted action IDs for factual probes, identical across arms. Missing keys are unmeasured, never perfect.

future_extension: If independently authored tasks need other controller counts, graph depth or outcome types, specify a successor interface and review before freezing; never silently squeeze them into an incompatible scorer.
